summary: Agent signing accounts get their own evidence trust level, agent/ALIAS: admitted where host keys are (pull requests only), additionally held to the accepted base's lane definition, and revocable one account at a time

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. The skip policy admits the agent level for two checks' wrapper kind and gains a per-level lane switch; no key is added here, so no agent note counts until a key line lands.

compatibility.detail: Existing fleet and host notes are judged as before. evidence-keygen defaults to the host level.

manual.detail: Adding an agent key is a later pull request that lists its line in .st/evidence-keys.

recovery.detail: Revert this change, or remove agent lines from .st/evidence-keys to revoke their notes.
